Anushka Lai is a high demon, appearing in Taimanin Asagi Battle Arena and sister of Aishwarya Lai.

Now, I'd usually never let those who bother my bathing go unpunished, but I'll give you credit for sneaking in this far. I like bold men like you. I should have fun with you tonight.
Anushka Lai

Personality
Anushka is a calm and very sexual woman that tries to seduce her targets, similar to her sister. She is far more cruel than her, bathing in the blood and gore of people she kills on a whim. She enjoys being a serious pervert, basically a nymphomaniac, and has no shyness to speak of. Furthermore, she kills people that cum too fast and gets sadistic pleasure from it, always talking in a highly sensual way. She normally is in total control and shows it, but should things not go her way, she reacts with anger.

Has a collection of "figures", melted and formed from like clay from people she liked, which she keeps as toys.

During her (What If) TABA event, she almost cries after losing her ability to feel pleasure and tells Fuuma Kotaro she will change her principles and become loyal to him if he restores her abilities, making her a bit of a pushover.

Appearance
She has slightly darker brown skin, a red jewel in her forehead, blue eyes and blond hair.

History
Background
The older sister of Aishwarya Lai, a skilled Witch.

A high ranking demon, which unlike her sister looks gentle but is much more evil, preferring to never leave her room and manipulate people from the distance. Spends her day bathing all day, and growths a collection of "figures" from her victims.

In the case her sister has died, she takes over the Crimson Tower.

Timeline TABA
She took over as one of the rulers of Amidahara after her Aishwarya Lai died and has been killing multiple people that get in her way or are unable to please her.

In her (What If) TABA event, Fuuma Kotarou tries to convince her to join his ranks and surprises her in a bath (filled with blood). She plans to use her ability on him to force him to have sex and simply die as soon as he cums. Fuuma however, is able to steal her ability away and eliminates all friction for him. Angered, Anushka tries to turn her bubbles into acid but is unable to do so, Fuuma explains that he not only took her power but also has in turn changed the friction in her genitals so that she will never feel pleasure ever again. Humping him in frustration to the verge of tears, she promises to change her ways and join his side and becoming his sex slave if he gives her powers back, which he promptly does.

Timeline RPG/Action
As Aishwarya Lai is alive, she is not in charge and not seen.

Powers/Abilities
Main Weapon: Soap

Bloody Soap: Creates bubbles that are made out of aphrodisiacs, she is mostly immune as she mixes chemicals with her own blood for that effect. She is also able to turn the bubbles to acid instantly.
Zero Friction: Her soap can reduce Friction to nothing or become really slippery to any attacks.
